name: EPIC 229019224
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 6.9 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 229019224 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.920513 (16th-84th percentiles 6.651048-7.202034), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,514 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.00 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,144 K at its surface.
